text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that continues the prior assertion while launching a fresh negated attribution

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negative particle opening the denied predicate frame
the poet-source speech phrase being denied
opening particle-and-pronoun frame that links continuation, negation, subject, and predicate marker

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not let 69:41 float as an isolated denial. It carries the assertion of 69:40 into a new defensive move: the same discourse that was affirmed as messenger-speech is now excluded from the poet-source category. Because the conjunction is fused in the opening flow with {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}), continuation and negation arrive together, and the short particle run {{ar:وَمَا هُوَ بِ}} ({{tr:wa-ma huwa bi}}) stages the frame before the heavier denied phrase {{ar:قَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ}} ({{tr:qawli shaʿirin}}).

topics.headline: continuation launches a new defense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 69:41 continues the prior assertion while beginning a fresh defensive denial.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) as a conjunction, while attachment support reads the following words as a negated nominal predication tied to the preceding discourse topic.

topics.headline: positive assertion becomes negative exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 69:40 and 69:41 as a paired source argument: affirmed messenger-speech, then excluded poet-speech.
topics.reason: The pronoun and predicate evidence keep one discourse topic in view across the ayah boundary, so the opening conjunction carries the prior claim into the negated attribution.

topics.headline: short particles stage the denied phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin with a compact run of function words before the denied source phrase lands.
topics.reason: The local surface joins the conjunction to the negative opening and then stacks pronoun and preposition before the predicate noun.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional predicate phrase whose poet-source classification is denied

words.prose: The first {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) scopes over the whole predicate {{ar:بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ}} ({{tr:bi-qawli shaʿirin}}), so the denial is not merely of one noun but of a complete source classification. The Hijazi and Tamimi parses locate the particle's governance differently, yet both preserve the same categorical negation. Its reprise later in the ayah is therefore not a duplicate function: word 2 negates the attribution, while word 8 reinforces or nominalizes the scarcity rebuke.

topics.headline: negation covers the whole predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah rejects a whole poet-source classification, not simply the occurrence of speech or the word poet by itself.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats {{ar:مَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ}} ({{tr:ma huwa bi-qawli shaʿirin}}) as one negated nominal predication.

topics.headline: Hijazi and Tamimi parses preserve one denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the grammar can be analyzed through different governance routes while the denied classification remains stable.
topics.reason: The local evidence confirms the negative particle and predicate frame; it supports the parse contrast as grammar apparatus but does not require choosing a different local meaning.

topics.headline: same surface leaves parse live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle's bare surface does not visibly mark which governance analysis is being used, while the surrounding frame carries the force.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a negative particle, and the prepositional predicate supplies the local denial frame.

topics.headline: repeated particle changes function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same particle sound in both beats while seeing one token negate attribution and the other support scarce belief.
topics.reason: QAC marks word 2 as negative and word 8 as expletive or reinforcing, and attachment evidence separates the first nominal clause from the later verbal rebuke.

words.gloss_range: independent third-person pronoun resuming the prior discourse topic as subject of the denied predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second-person plural belief verb closing the audience rebuke

words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) keeps the defended referent already in view from 69:40 instead of introducing a new subject, whether that referent is described as the Quranic discourse or the messenger's speech-act. As an independent pronoun, it stands visibly before the denied predicate and lets the clause classify what the discourse is not. The ayah then pivots from this third-person reference to the second-person close {{ar:تُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:tuʾminūna}}), moving from source classification to direct audience rebuke.

topics.headline: same referent carried forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one defended discourse across the positive and negative predicates, even if the referent is described as the Quranic discourse or the messenger's speech-act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) as a 3ms pronoun resuming the prior discourse topic, while the exact explanatory noun remains contextually supplied rather than locally overt.

topics.headline: independent pronoun stages identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the referent standing as the subject before the exclusion arrives, making the denial a classification rather than an event report.
topics.reason: QAC marks an independent pronoun, and the attachment evidence parses the first beat as a nominal predication about it.

topics.headline: classification pivots into confrontation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah move from speaking about the message to confronting the hearers' deficient trust.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from the 3ms pronoun to the 2mp verb, and attachment evidence marks the final verb's second-person plural subject agreement.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the denial more than a bare nominal rejection. It governs {{ar:قَوْلِ}} ({{tr:qawli}}) as the genitive core of the predicate and, in the familiar negative frame, also strengthens the categorical exclusion. The result is a compact {{ar:مَا ... بِ}} ({{tr:ma ... bi}}) frame that seals the first beat before the ayah turns to the audience's scarce belief.

topics.headline: emphatic preposition strengthens denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the denial as strengthened by the prepositional particle rather than expressed as a plain bare predicate.
topics.reason: The reference evidence treats the phrase as a negated nominal predication and identifies {{ar:قَوْلِ}} ({{tr:qawli}}) as governed through the preposition.

topics.headline: preposition builds the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denied speech phrase enter as one governed predicate unit, not as an ungoverned label.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:بِقَوْلِ}} ({{tr:bi-qawli}}) the prepositional predicate of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), with genitive government on the speech noun.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first beat close as a complete source-class exclusion before the rebuke begins.
topics.reason: The local syntax closes the negated predicate before the separate verbal clause beginning with the scarcity phrase.

words.prose: {{ar:قَوْلِ}} ({{tr:qawli}}) is the predicate head around which the first beat is built, and its qaf-stop opening with lam close makes the speech noun a compact acoustic hinge before the poet label completes it. In construct with {{ar:شَاعِرٍ}} ({{tr:shaʿirin}}), it makes the issue source-authorship: not speech produced by a poet. The noun's maṣdar shape treats the discourse as an attributable product, and the surrounding passage keeps the same root active from the affirmed messenger-speech in 69:40 through the denied poet and soothsayer sources in 69:41-42 and the fabrication threat in 69:44. The poet-source phrase also enters a wider accusation field (52:30, 37:36, 21:5), while the repeated scarcity frame in 69:42 shifts the indicted response from trust to remembrance. Because the next beat ends with {{ar:تُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:tuʾminūna}}), this speech noun also sets up belief as a response to authenticated utterance.

topics.headline: construct makes poet a source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase targets authorship or source, while the weaker speech-about-a-poet parse remains only an apparatus contrast.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:شَاعِرٍ}} ({{tr:shaʿirin}}) as the genitive complement of the construct noun, and the local denied predicate favors a source relation.

topics.headline: maṣdar names attributable discourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial as an identity judgment about an attributable discourse product, not as a report that someone spoke.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a genitive verbal noun, and attachment evidence makes it the semantic head of the prepositional predicate.

topics.headline: speech root prepares fabrication contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ordinary attributable speech here preparing the later stronger fabrication contrast in 69:44 without making fabrication the local sense of the word.
topics.reason: The local word is the plain speech maṣdar, so derivational fabrication pressure is retained as passage-level contrast rather than imported as the selected local meaning.

topics.headline: speech calls for trust response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief in the second beat is response to a disputed utterance-source, not a disconnected moral statement.
topics.reason: The ayah places the speech noun in the denied predicate and the trust verb in the following rebuke, while contextual evidence supports a strong speech-trust pairing.

topics.headline: root recurs through the passage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one speech-root thread as the passage sorts affirmed, denied, and hypothetically fabricated sources across 69:40-44.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references, and no local evidence blocks treating the recurrence as passage-level source classification.

topics.headline: parallel denials join accusation field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this speech phrase as part of a polemical pattern: poet-source denial here, soothsayer-source denial in 69:42, and wider accusation passages such as 52:30, 37:36, and 21:5.
topics.reason: The topic is kept as inter-ayah and formula evidence; local grammar limits it to a parallel or accusation-field payoff rather than making those other scenes govern the local parse.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the speech noun as the compact hinge of the first predicate before the poet label completes it.
topics.reason: The row adds a minor but coherent sound observation tied to the local predicate head.

words.prose: {{ar:شَاعِرٍ}} ({{tr:shaʿirin}}) completes the construct phrase by naming the denied source class: not the saying of a poet. Its genitive, indefinite active-participle form excludes an unspecific class of poetic agents rather than a single named person or merely the genre of poetry. The root's perception and sign field sharpens the denial, because the message is not being reduced to the product of heightened human perception or crafted poetic knowing; still, the local selected sense remains the poet-source label. The rare participial label is a marked accusation word rather than a routine occupational description, and as the final lexical item before the pause it lets the excluded class land before the scarcity rebuke begins. The word is answered here by negation and paired with the next denied knowledge-type in 69:42.

topics.headline: poet completes the denied source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the poet label as an agentive source complement to the speech noun, not merely as a genre tag.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:شَاعِرٍ}} ({{tr:shaʿirin}}) the genitive complement of the construct speech noun, and QAC marks it as an active participle.

topics.headline: indefiniteness excludes the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is not limited to one named poet but excludes the poet category as an explanatory source.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as genitive indefinite, completing an indefinite source category within the construct.

topics.headline: perception root deepens what is denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the poet-source denial as also resisting reduction to human perception, sign-making, or sensitive composition, while the local noun remains poet.
topics.reason: V4 separates poetry, perception, sign, and hair-related branches; the local active participle selects the poet branch, with related perception/sign pressure preserved as narrowed resonance.

topics.reason: The contextual profile shows a small exact-form set and a high quoted or polemical profile, matching the CRITICAL accusation-field rows.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 69:41 and 69:42 rejecting rival knowledge-source labels in sequence: poetic perception here and divinatory claim in the next ayah.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the consecutive source-label contrast, and local syntax supports the current word as the first denied source class.

topics.reason: The word is the final lexical item of the nominal denial before the separate verbal clause begins.

words.prose: {{ar:قَلِيلًا}} ({{tr:qalīlan}}) opens the second beat by putting scarcity before the believing verb, so the audience hears paucity before the response being measured is named. Its accusative adverbial role measures the response as scant, and the idiom {{ar:قَلِيلًا مَا}} ({{tr:qalīlan ma}}) presses the quantity toward rhetorical near-negation rather than a neutral statistic. Because it is indefinite and qualitative, the word does not count an exact amount or compare one group with another; it makes paucity itself the rebuke. The same scarcity frame returns in 69:42 with a remembrance or reflection verb and appears in formulas such as 7:3, so the local failure of trust is heard as the first half of a paired cognitive rebuke.

topics.headline: accusative measures believing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that scarcity is grammatically applied to the believing response, whether framed as action-measure or state-description.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats {{ar:قَلِيلًا}} ({{tr:qalīlan}}) as an adverbial modifier of {{ar:تُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:tuʾminūna}}), while the alternate grammatical labels remain compatible with measuring the believing act.

topics.headline: little presses toward almost none
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the word little as censure that minimizes the audience's trust toward near-zero, not as calm arithmetic.
topics.reason: V4 supports a fewness branch with minimization and uses of little for negation or rarity, and the local construction is explicitly marked as a rebuke formula.

topics.headline: form keeps scarcity unspecific
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the word assigns open-ended paucity directly to believing rather than giving an exact count or comparative measure.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an accusative indefinite qualitative adjective, not a comparative or counted noun.

topics.headline: scarcity formula returns in the next denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this scarcity phrase as a recognizable rebuke frame that returns in 69:42 and belongs with scarcity formulas such as 7:3.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete formula parallels, and the local attachment evidence identifies {{ar:قَلِيلًا مَا}} ({{tr:qalīlan ma}}) as a construction unit.

topics.headline: fronting starts the rebuke with paucity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader encounters failure first, before the verb reveals that the measured response is belief or trust.
topics.reason: The word begins the second clause and precedes the belief verb, so scarcity is foregrounded as the entry point into the rebuke.

words.prose: The second {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) is the hinge inside {{ar:قَلِيلًا مَا تُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:qalīlan ma tuʾminūna}}). It can reinforce the fronted scarcity word or nominalize the believing act, and both routes preserve the same rebuke: belief is scant. Because the particle is uninflected, the surface keeps that reparse live while separating {{ar:قَلِيلًا}} ({{tr:qalīlan}}) from {{ar:تُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:tuʾminūna}}). Its echo of the first {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) gives the ayah a two-beat sound link, but the grammatical functions sharply diverge.

topics.headline: two parses preserve one rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees two grammatical routes to the same scarcity rebuke: reinforcement of little, or nominalization of the believing act.
topics.reason: QAC labels this token as expletive or reinforcing, while CRITICAL preserves the maṣdariyya parse as a compatible grammatical route; local translation support treats the phrase as one compressed construction.

topics.reason: The token stands between the fronted accusative and the belief verb, and its surface form does not mark one parse over the other.

topics.reason: QAC differentiates word 2 as negative and word 8 as expletive or reinforcing, while attachment evidence separates the two clauses.

words.prose: {{ar:تُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:tuʾminūna}}) makes the ayah land on the hearers' response. The Form IV verb casts belief as granting trust or authenticated status, not as merely being safe, and the objectless frame lets the rebuke broaden while context still points back to the defended discourse. Its imperfect second-person plural form makes the verdict ongoing and collective, directly confronting the audience; the accepted third-person variant {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūna}}) shows how much force depends on that prefix, shifting the same scarcity verdict into reported description. After the denial of {{ar:قَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ}} ({{tr:qawli shaʿirin}}), the closing verb turns source classification into a judgment on scarce trust. That final trust failure keeps the surah's belief thread active from 69:33 and points forward to the parallel scarcity rebuke in 69:42. Phonetically, the internal hamza checks the closing verb while the long plural ending stabilizes the ayah-ending rebuke.

topics.headline: objectless verb broadens the rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb does not name an explicit object, so the rebuke can sound broad while still being contextually aimed at the defended message.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the local frame as objectless or intransitive, so an elided-object reading must remain contextual rather than overtly supplied.

topics.headline: imperfect states ongoing response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an ongoing collective verdict on the addressees, not an imperative command to believe inside this ayah.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the form as imperfect Form IV, second masculine plural, indicative, and attachment evidence marks the subject agreement as morphologically present.

topics.headline: variant exposes address versus report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the standard reading confront the hearers directly, while the accepted third-person variant would report them instead.
topics.reason: The local QAC form is second person plural, and the variant contrast is retained as rhetorical apparatus rather than replacement of the aligned surface.

topics.headline: Form IV casts belief as granting trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels belief here as granting trust or authentication to the message, while the base safety branch remains root pressure rather than the local verb sense.
topics.reason: QAC marks the local verb as Form IV, so the safety root family is narrowed into a trust or belief response rather than read as being physically safe.

topics.headline: belief responds to disputed speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final verb as the audience's authentication response to the qawl whose poetic source has just been denied.
topics.reason: The local structure pairs a speech-source denial with a trust verb, and contextual evidence supports a strong speech-trust co-occurrence field.

topics.headline: closing word shifts to response failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah's endpoint shift from denying the poet label to judging the hearers' deficient trust.
topics.reason: The verb is the final word of the verbal rebuke clause after the completed nominal source denial.

topics.headline: belief thread and scarcity formula extend outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the local lack of trust to the surah's belief thread and to the parallel scarcity rebuke that follows in 69:42.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide same-surah and next-ayah links, and local grammar keeps them as echo and formula evidence rather than alternate local meanings.

topics.headline: hamza and ending shape the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing rebuke as phonetically checked by the internal catch and stabilized by the long plural ending.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the local surface and final position, though it remains secondary to the lexical and structural topics.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated construction attaches poet to qawl, while qalilan ma tu'minun comments on the hearers' response.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus does not erase the existence of articulated discourse. It denies poetic ownership or production of that discourse, then diagnoses trusting assent as scarce.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the verbal artifact that remains present while its proposed poetic source is negated.
Poetry and poetic practice supply the specifically denied mode of human production.
Fewness makes the audience's assent scarce rather than making the discourse itself slight.
Trusting confirmation identifies the scarce event as inward assent to the report.

changed_reading.before: This is simply not poetry, and the audience barely believes it.
changed_reading.after: A real utterance is present, but its attribution to poetic production is denied; the shortage lies in the hearers' trusting uptake.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Qawl in the negated genitive construction can activate attribution and circulating report, while sha'ir supplies the disputed label.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can answer a social act of classification: a report circulates, assigns the discourse to a poet, and is rejected as false attribution. The closing clause exposes why that label persists: assent to the discourse's own claim is rare.

activation_trace.role: False saying or false attribution turns the negation into correction of assigned authorship.
Circulating public talk supplies the social channel through which the poet label can become established.
The poet and poetic craft supply the public category being refused.
Trusting confirmation supplies the alternative response that the audience seldom gives.

changed_reading.before: The verse classifies the text as non-poetry.
changed_reading.after: The verse interrupts a circulating attribution: calling this a poet's production is itself a false public account of the qawl.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of sha'ir also carries fine perception, while iman carries settled security and confirmation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Poetic sensitivity and subtle noticing are not allowed to explain the discourse's source. The audience may register its signs without moving into settled trust, so the line contrasts perceptive contact with secure assent.

activation_trace.role: Fine awareness supplies a human perceptive capacity that is near the poet root but insufficient as a source account.
A thing's indication lets the qawl function as a sign encountered by the audience.
Fewness limits how often perception matures into the response named next.
Settled security supplies the heart-level state that mere noticing has not produced.

changed_reading.before: The audience fails to recognize a non-poetic text.
changed_reading.after: Recognition or sensitivity may occur, yet it rarely settles into trust; the line separates perceptual contact from secure assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath over what is seen and not seen widens the evidentiary field immediately before the source labels. The poet classification can therefore be read as an inference from visible form that fails to account for an unseen provenance.

activation_trace.role: Subtle human perception anchors the focus as an attempted act of source recognition.
Trusting confirmation anchors the response that perception has not secured.
The oath branch supplies a formally pledged evidentiary frame for the ensuing attribution claim.
Eye-sight supplies the visible side of the audience's available evidence.
Heart-insight extends seeing beyond surfaces and makes a deeper source judgment possible.

structural_cues: The paired objects ma tubṣiruna and ma la tubṣirun immediately precede the qawl source sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an oath and paired visible/invisible seeing; I infer that surface genre recognition is being tested against a wider provenance field; a live alternative is that the pair only intensifies the oath without specifying how the poet claim arose.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies an obvious literary genre label.
changed_reading.after: The focus corrects a source judgment made from visible verbal form alone, under an oath that includes what the audience cannot see.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same qawl that is denied to a poet is affirmatively attached to an honored messenger. The contrast preserves the utterance while changing the human role from composing poet to commissioned carrier.

activation_trace.role: Poetic craft anchors the focus-side role that the negation excludes.
Articulated speech establishes that qawl is affirmed immediately before its poetic attribution is denied.
Sending and being dispatched supply the messenger's functional role as bearer rather than originator.
Messenger and message make the agency relation explicit and distinguish delivery from poetic manufacture.
Commended honor qualifies the carrier and opposes the suspicion of deceptive production.

structural_cues: 69:40 affirms innahu la-qawlu rasulin karim, and 69:41 immediately negates bi-qawli sha'ir.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored qawl-attributions and a dispatched messenger; I infer a contrast between carrying and composing; a live alternative is that rasul marks only the proximate reciter, leaving the ultimate authorship relation to later context.

changed_reading.before: The statement is not a poet's utterance.
changed_reading.after: It remains qawl at the human mouth, but the mouth belongs to a commissioned messenger, not a composing poet.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse repeats qawl and qalilan while replacing poet with a diviner and belief with remembrance. Together the pair excludes both crafted verse and claims to hidden news, while diagnosing deficient assent and deficient recollection in the hearers.

activation_trace.role: Poetry supplies the first excluded human production channel.
Trusting assent supplies the first scarce audience response.
Repeated articulated speech binds the two excluded source labels to one discourse.
The diviner's claim to hidden reports supplies a second, distinct human explanation of the discourse.
Repeated fewness makes the paired audience deficits structurally equivalent.
Recovering what was forgotten supplies the second scarce response and links reception to retained recognition.

structural_cues: 69:41 and 69:42 form a parallel pair: wa-ma/wa-la bi-qawli X, qalilan ma Y-un.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel syntax, poet, diviner, belief, and remembrance; I infer a two-channel exclusion paired with a two-stage uptake failure; a live alternative is that the second verse merely accumulates another denial without mapping belief and memory onto stages.

changed_reading.before: The focus rejects poetry and complains of unbelief.
changed_reading.after: The focus is half of a controlled double contrast: neither poetic craft nor hidden-news divination explains the qawl, and the hearers fail both to assent and to retain recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent and delivery from the Lord supply an upstream origin for the messenger's qawl. Poet is therefore not merely the wrong occupational label; poetic composition is the wrong causal direction.

activation_trace.role: The spoken artifact anchors what needs a causal source account.
Poetic production anchors the rejected bottom-up account of how the artifact arose.
Caused descent and delivery supply a directed transmission into the messenger's speech.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the upstream authority from whom the delivery proceeds.

structural_cues: 69:43 follows both source denials with the nominal clause tanzilun min rabbi l-'alamin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery downward and sovereign source; I infer a transmission chain that distinguishes origin from voiced carriage; a live alternative is that descent names mode or status without specifying every agency boundary.

changed_reading.before: The discourse is not made by a poet.
changed_reading.after: The discourse arrives through downward delivery from a sovereign source, so its human voicing must not be mistaken for human origination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counterfactual of fabricating sayings is followed by seizure, severing the life-artery, and the absence of any barrier. This makes source fidelity a bodily enforced custody: the messenger can utter the qawl but cannot author additions under that commission.

activation_trace.role: False attribution anchors the exact source error that the focus refuses.
Poetic manufacture supplies the unauthorized authorship model under dispute.
Fabricated or falsely assigned sayings supply the forbidden breach of transmission.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing initiates the sanction for a breach.
Power and right make the seizure an exercise of authority rather than an accidental injury.
Severing supplies the irreversible action that terminates false transmission.
The life-artery locates the sanction at the carrier's bodily condition of continued speech.
An intervening barrier, explicitly unavailable, closes off rescue from the sanction.

structural_cues: The conditional law wa-law taqawwala ... la-akhadhna ... thumma la-qata'na ... fa-ma minkum ... hajizin forms a breach-to-sanction chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false saying, authoritative seizure, bodily severing, and no interposer; I infer that messenger speech is custody under sanction and therefore not poetic authorship; a live alternative is that the sequence certifies truthfulness without inviting a general transmission model.

changed_reading.before: Calling the discourse poetry is an inaccurate genre judgment.
changed_reading.after: Calling it a poet's qawl violates a guarded authorship boundary: the commissioned speaker is bodily answerable not to insert or claim sayings of his own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse is named a reminder for those who place themselves in protection. This turns the focus's scarce belief from a bare opinion count into failure to use remembered truth as protective orientation.

activation_trace.role: Fewness anchors the deficient uptake that the later function clarifies.
Settled security anchors belief as a state with protective consequences.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the discourse's practical reception function.
Ward-off protection supplies the consequence toward which remembered assent can orient the hearer.

structural_cues: 69:48 predicates tadhkirah of the same discourse and assigns it to al-muttaqin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder and protection; I infer that retained recognition enables protective response; a live alternative is that protective disposition precedes and selects for remembrance rather than being produced by it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant qawl-to-q-l-l mapping and a carrying branch rather than the ordinary speech branch. It remains anchored in focus qawl and is independently activated by dispatch and downward delivery in 69:40 and 69:43. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for transmission, never as a lexical replacement for qawl.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus qawl is explicitly split-mapped to a branch of bearing and rising, while the surrounding sequence names a messenger and a delivered descent.

activation_trace.role: Bearing and lifting turn the focus qawl into an exploratory image of a load carried without being authored by its carrier.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the qawl behaves like entrusted cargo: the messenger bears a delivered load, whereas a poet would be treated as its maker.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because rattling and unstable motion is a distant q-l-l branch and cannot gloss qalilan directly. It remains anchored by the focus adjacency of fewness and heart-security, then gains a clean opposite in 69:51's fixed knowledge. Downstream prose should qualify it as a kinetic analogy for reception, not historical morphology or primary syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qalilan immediately modifies an iman-root response, allowing instability from q-l-l to interact with the security pole of iman.

activation_trace.role: Rattling and failure to stay fixed supply a material image for the hearers' unstable reception.
Settled security supplies the stable state that the rattling reception fails to attain.

changed_reading.before: The hearers believe only in small quantity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their reception also rattles without settling, while the discourse is later characterized by unwavering certainty.

strongest_changes: The qawl is preserved but its human role is reassigned from composing poet to commissioned messenger.
Descent and the fabrication-sanction sequence separate ultimate origin, authorized carriage, and forbidden addition.
The paired poet/diviner denials turn scarce belief into a broader failure of assent, remembrance, and protective uptake.
Covering and false attribution can reverse into exposure and regret while truth remains fixed certainty.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation was not genre comparison alone but a custody model: an uttered qawl can belong to a messenger as carried delivery without becoming his composition. The split qawl mapping also preserved a contained image of bearing a consignment, while q-l-l instability and cover/uncover branches exposed kinetic and material readings of audience refusal.
remaining_uncertainties: Qawl of a messenger may denote proximate voicing, authorized possession, or both; the context supports but does not fully collapse those relations.
The carrying image from the non-dominant qawl mapping is structurally illuminating but too branch-distant to serve as a lexical claim.
The instability reading of qalilan competes with the straightforward quantitative and near-negative force of fewness.
The cover-to-uncover reversal depends on carrying a non-primary branch of hasrah alongside its direct regret sense.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Poetic production excluded from the transmission chain.** **ش ع ر B007** (poetry and poet) is negated as a source of **ق و ل B001** (uttered speech), directly before revelation is sourced in 69:43. The packet supplies competing speech classifications and explicit descent; I infer that the issue is provenance, not denial that the discourse has verbal form. The ayah reads as a source correction.
2. **Subtle awareness fails to become assent.** **ش ع ر B005** (subtle knowing and awareness) is latently activated beside negated **ء م ن B002** (trusting assent and confirmation). The packet supplies minimal faith and a root that can denote fine perception; I infer that aesthetic or subtle sensing is insufficient unless it becomes trusting confirmation. This is exploratory because `شاعر` directly selects B007.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:43 supplies the positive source after this exclusion, showing that the contrast concerns provenance rather than verbal or aesthetic form alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Poetry is rejected as a source-model, not as mere verbal beauty.** `ش ع ر` B007 is "poetry and poet," while B005 is "subtle knowing and awareness." The line follows messenger-speech and precedes soothsayer-speech, with seen/unseen reality behind both alternatives. B007 identifies the proposed genre/source; B005 assigns it an epistemic claim of subtle perception. The packet supplies rival accounts of how unseen-relevant speech arises; I infer that the negation rejects poetic sensitivity as the causal source, not every poetic feature. The ayah reads as source discrimination rather than aesthetic criticism.
2. **Little assent also means little security is established.** `ق ل ل` B001 is fewness; `ء م ن` B002 is trusting assent and B001 is settled security. The accusative `قَلِيلًا` is mirrored by little remembering in 69:42, while the preceding punitive sequence showed the insecurity attached to non-assent. B002 supplies scarce reception; B001 supplies the protective relation that scarce reception fails to settle. The packet gives fewness and earlier exposure; I infer deficient assent -> deficient security. `قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ` reads as a thinly established trust-relation, not only a low count of beliefs.
3. **True saying is separated from false attribution.** `ق و ل` B001 is uttered speech and B005 is "false saying or false attribution." The negated poet-attribution sits between the affirmed `قَوْلُ رَسُولٍ` and the hypothetical `تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا` in 69:44. B001 identifies the real utterance; B005 supplies the rejected attribution mechanism. The packet gives affirmation, negation, and forgery test; I infer that correct source-assignment is the issue binding them. The repeated `قَوْل` reads as an audit of attribution.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:48 later identifies the discourse positively as `تَذْكِرَةٌ`, and 69:51 as certain truth. Those functions correct the poet proposal more precisely than a denial of style: the fixed speech is meant to admonish, protect, and establish, whereas `ش ع ر` B005/B007 would locate its causal source in poetic awareness and production. The late labels validate source/function discrimination.

baseline.text: O bir şairin sözü değildir. Pek az inanıyorsunuz.

findings.text: Şair sözü nitelemesinin reddi, söylemin estetik özelliklerini değil, şiir üretimini onun nedensel kaynağı saymayı dışlar.
İnce sezgi ve estetik farkındalık, güvenerek onaylamaya dönüşmedikçe yeterli değildir; ancak bu, şair sözcüğünün doğrudan şiir anlamının yanında uzak bir çağrışımdır.
İnancın azlığı, yalnız görüş sayısının düşüklüğü değil, güven ilişkisinin ve onun sağlayacağı güvenliğin zayıf kurulmasıdır.
Gerçek elçi sözü ile uydurma isnat arasındaki tekrar, ayeti sözün biçiminden çok doğru kaynağa bağlanmasını denetleyen bir halkaya dönüştürür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.

Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninde çıkan kıl; tek tel, yoğun ya da uzun kıllılık ve toynak çevresindeki kıllı deri halkası bunun bedensel görünümleridir. Meyve ya da böcek yüzeyindeki kılı andıran ince tüy de benzetmeye dayalı bir uzantıdır.

facets.statement: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninde çıkan kıl ve bunun tek teli dalın temel anlamıdır.
Başın ya da bedenin kıllarının çok veya uzun olması, temel anlamın nitelik bildiren görünümüdür.
Toynağın çevresinde, derinin bitip kılın başladığı halka biçimli bölüm bu alanda özel bir beden parçasıdır.
Bazı meyve ve böceklerin yüzeyindeki kılı andıran ince tüy, görünüş benzerliğiyle bu dala bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tablosu bedensel kılı ve tek telini merkeze alır; çok ya da uzun kıllılığı, toynak çevresindeki kıllı bölgeyi ve meyve ile böcek yüzeyindeki ince tüyü buna bağlı görünümler olarak bir araya getirir.

facets.statement: Bir arazide ağaçların veya bitkilerin çok ve sık bulunması temel görünümü oluşturur.

Yeşil ile kül rengi arasında görünen belirli bir çalı ya da tuzcul bitki türü ayrıca bu dalda adlandırılır.

concept_map.definition: Arpa ve onun tek tanesi dalın çekirdeğidir. Bıçak ağzını sapa tutturmaya yarayan küçük metal parça, arpa biçimli süs parçası ve küçük hıyarlar tanenin biçimi ya da küçüklüğü üzerinden adlandırılan uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Arpa bitkisinin yenebilir tanesi ve bunun tek bir adedi temel anlamı oluşturur.
Bıçak ağzını sapa bağlayan küçük metal parça, taneye benzetilen işlevsel bir uzantıdır.
Altın ya da gümüşten yapılan arpa tanesi biçimli küçük süs parçası, biçim benzerliğine dayanır.
Küçük hıyarlar, küçüklük ve tane görünümü üzerinden aynı adlandırma alanına alınır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tene doğrudan değen giysiyi temel alır ve bu bedensel yakınlığı en yakın kişi ile insanın içine yerleşen kaygı, korku, sevgi ve hastalık durumlarına aktarır. Geçici çerçeve yakınlık ve içe yerleşme bağını doğru kurar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tene temas eden iç giysi ile onun yakınlık ve içe sinme benzetmelerine özgüdür; topluluğu tanıtan ortak çağrı veya tören belirtisi bu anlamdan ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karışık ve yalın olmayan kapsam, iç giysi çekirdeğini yakın kişi ve içe yerleşen duygu kalıplarından ayırmayı gerektirir; bu kalıplar genel bir giyinme anlamına çevrilmez.

concept_map.definition: Tene doğrudan değen, öteki giysilerin altında kalan iç giysi dalın çekirdeğidir. Bu yakınlık, bir kişinin en yakın ve en özel kimse olması ile kaygı, korku, sevgi ya da hastalığın insanın içine yerleşip onu sarması için benzetme olur.

facets.statement: Öteki giysilerin altında tene doğrudan değen iç giysi temel anlamdır.
Tene en yakın giysi benzetmesi, bir kişinin başkasına en yakın ve en özel kimse oluşunu anlatır.
Kaygı ve korkunun insanın içine yerleşip sürekli ona eşlik etmesi, giysinin bedene yapışmasına benzetilir.
Sevginin kişiyi hastalıkla sarması ya da bir şeyi bedene değen iç giysi kılma kullanımları aynı yakın temas tasarımını sürdürür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatısı tene değen iç giysiyi merkez alır; en yakın kişi, insanın içine yerleşen kaygı ve korku, sevginin doğurduğu hastalık ve bir şeyi iç giysi kılma kullanımları bu yakın temasın uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İç giysiyi ve bu giysinin yakınlığı üzerinden kurulan kişi, duygu, hastalık ve giydirme uzantılarını birlikte karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi fark edip bilme, ona dikkatle uyanma, bilmeyi dileme, bilgiyi sağlayan şeyi sorma ve duyular yoluyla algılama kullanımlarını birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve ince farkındalık ve algı ortaklığını doğru biçimde yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, salt depolanmış bilgiden çok fark etme ve algıyla belirginleşen bilmeyi kapsar; ölçülü söz ya da dış dünyadaki belirti yalnız bilinmeye aracılık ederse bu alana yaklaşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karışık ve yalın olmayan kapsam, fark edip bilme çekirdeğini bilme dileği, bilgi sorusu ve duyulara özgü kalıplardan ayırmayı gerektirir; kalıp anlamları bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ince bir dikkatle fark etmek, algılamak ve böylece bilmek dalın çekirdeğidir. Bilmeyi dile getiren kalıp, neyin bilgi vereceğini soran anlatım ve algıyı sağlayan duyular bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi dikkatle fark edip algılayarak bilmek temel anlamı oluşturur.
Bir durumu bilmeyi dileme ve neyin onu bildireceğini sorma kalıpları, bilme çekirdeğinin söylem içindeki kullanımlarıdır.
Görme, işitme ve benzeri duyular, dünyayı algılayıp bilmeye yarayan yetiler olarak bu alana bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tablosu dikkatle fark edip bilmeyi merkeze alır; bilmeyi dileme, bir şeyi neyin bildireceğini sorma ve duyuları algı yolları olarak adlandırma kullanımları bu çekirdeğin çevresinde toplanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi topluluğun savaşta kullandığı tanıtıcı çağrıyı, kutsal ziyaretin belirti ve uygulamalarını, tören yerini, adanmış hayvanı kanatarak tanınır kılmayı ve bir insanı yaralayıp kanatmayı birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve belirti ve kanla belirleme bağını doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karışık ve yalın olmayan kapsam, genel belirti alanını savaş çağrısı, kutsal tören ve kanatarak işaretleme kalıplarından ayırmayı gerektirir; özel uygulamalar genel anlama yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğu ya da adanmış varlığı tanınır kılan belirti veya ortak çağrı dalın çekirdeğidir. Savaşta ayırt edici çağrı, kutsal ziyaretin belirti, uygulama ve yerleri, adanmış hayvanı kanatarak belirleme ve bir insanı saplayarak kanatma bunun özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğun üyelerinin birbirini tanımasını sağlayan ortak savaş çağrısı veya belirti temel anlamdır.
Kutsal ziyaretin tanıtıcı belirtileri, uygulamaları, adanmış hayvanı ve belirlenmiş tören yeri bu çekirdeğin dinsel özelleşmesidir.
Adanmış hayvanın hörgücünü yaralayıp kan akıtarak onun adanmış olduğunu görünür kılma, eylemli bir belirleme biçimidir.
Bir insanı mızrak ya da benzeri araçla saplayıp kanatmak, belirleme amacından ayrılmış kanatma uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kaynak anlatısı savaşta tanınmayı sağlayan çağrı veya belirtiyi, kutsal ziyaretin göstergelerini ve uygulamalarını, tören yerini ve adanmış hayvanı kanatarak belirleme işlemini bir araya getirir; insanı saplayarak kanatma da eylemin genişlemiş kullanımıdır.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir ölçüyle ve çoğu kez uyakla kurulmuş söz sanatı dalın çekirdeğidir. Bu sözü söyleyen kişi ve uğraşı, sözle yarışıp üstün gelme eylemi ve mecazen yalan söze ya da yanıltıcı kanıta aktarılan kullanım buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Belirli ölçü ve uyak düzeni taşıyan söz, dalın temel sanat ve ürün anlamıdır.
Ölçülü uyaklı söz söyleyen kişi ve bu işi edinme ya da yapmaya çalışma, sanatın katılımcı ve uğraş boyutudur.
İki kişinin ölçülü söz söyleyerek yarışması ve birinin ötekine üstün gelmesi, sanatın karşılıklı eylem kullanımını oluşturur.
Ölçülü sözün yalan söz veya yanıltıcı kanıt anlamında kullanılması, olumsuz değerlendirmeye dayalı aktarılmış bir uzantıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem guven halini hem de guvenilirlik ve emanet iliskisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun giderilmesi ve ic yatiskinligi onde oldugunda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Korku karsiti guven halini korur.
error_profile.loses: Emanet, guvenilirlik ve guven verme boyutlarini disarida birakir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin baskasini koruma ve teminat altina almasi anlatildiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bir baskasina guven saglama iliskisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Guven icinde bulunma ve guvenilirlik adlandirmalarini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kisi, emanet ya da dayanikli nesne guvenilirlik niteliginde anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Guvenilir sayilma ve emanet edilebilir olma tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Korkudan emin olma halini ve guven verme eylemini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir haberin, vaadin veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasi alanini kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisinde de kalbin yatismasi ve guven hissi bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda yatiskinlik korkudan emin olma ve guvenilirlik sonucudur; komsu dalda yatiskinlik dogru sayma ve kabul etme iliskisine baglidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Korku karsiti guvenligi, guven vermeyi ve emanet iliskisini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir seye alisma, yakinlik duyma ve ona icten dayanma tarafini one cikarir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kalbin bir seye karsi yatismasi ve guven duymasi vardir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal ic yakinlik ve dayanma tarafinda yogunlasir; bu dal ise korkusuzluk, teminat ve guvenilirlik kurumunu da semantik cekirdege alir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Emanet, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma gibi iliskileri de tasir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nefis, aile veya kalp genisligi ve sakin mizac alaninda durur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi kisinin ic dunyasinda guven ve rahatlik tasvir edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal guvenin nesnel veya iliskisel teminatini anlatabilir; komsu dal ise rahat gonullu ve genis ic durumunu anlatir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Guven hali, guven verme ve guvenilirlik adlandirmalaridir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koruyan engel, dayanak veya cevreden gelen himaye unsurudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Guvenli olma durumu koruma fikriyle ayni senaryoda bulusabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal guvenin sebebi olabilecek koruyucu yapida durur; bu dal ise guvenin hali, verilmesi ve guvenilirlik vasfini adlandirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Haber, vaat, hakikat ve dini baglanma kullanimlarini tasdik cekirdegi etrafinda birlestirir.

error_profile.preserves: Dogru sayma, ic kabul ve daha ozel dini baglanma imkanini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Haber veya sozun dogrulanmasi anlatildiginda en dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Tasdik cekirdegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dini boyun egme ve davranisla baglanma tarafini tam tasimaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dini ve icten kabullenme baglamlarinda tasdikten daha genis sureci aciklar.

error_profile.preserves: Tasdikle birlikte ic kabul ve baglanma tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sade haber tasdiki icin fazla agir ve ozel kalir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vaat edilen seyin gercek ve guvenilir kilinmasi baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Vaatle ilgili dogrulama tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tasdik ve dini kabullenme alanlarini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dua sonunda soylenen sabit kabul talebi ve onu soyleme eylemi icin genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Dua baglamini, kabul istegini ve sabit soz niteligini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sozun dua icindeki anlamini eylemli bicimde cevirmek gerektiginde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Duanin kabul edilmesini isteme tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sabit soz ve onu soyleme eylemi olma tarafini eksiltir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duanin sonucuna katilma ve gerceklesmesini dileme baglaminda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Kabul ve gerceklesme istegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ilahi muhataba yonelen talep kuvvetini ve sozu soyleme eylemini tam tasimaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylem adi olan kullanimda, yani bu sozu telaffuz etme anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sozu soyleme eylemini ve dua baglamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sozun tek basina anlamini ve ad yorumu yanini kapsamaz.

error_profile.adds: Korkudan emin olma ve guvenilirlik alanlarini ekler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yayinlanan ayrimlar dua, dua cevabi, yalvarma ve ayni kokteki iki ayri dali kapsar; kalan adaylar ibadet, kehanet araci veya uzak dua sozleri olarak daha az dogrudan sinir bilgisi verdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آمين في الدعاء بالمد والقصر، والتأمين بمعنى قول آمين، وتفسيرها باستجب أو اللهم افعل أو كذلك فليكن، مع ذكر قول من جعلها اسما من أسماء الله.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأمن ضد الخوف، ولا الأمانة، ولا الإيمان بمعنى التصديق، ولا أمن التي هي أم من وليست من الباب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: قولنا في الدعاء آمين وتفسيره اللهم افعل (maqayis)؛ التأمين من قولك آمين (ayn)؛ آمين في الدعاء يمد ويقصر ومعناه كذلك فليكن (sihah)؛ آمين يقال بالمد والقصر وهو اسم للفعل ومعناه استجب وأمن فلان إذا قال آمين (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Bu kok ailesi guven ve korkusuzluk, dogru sayip kabul etme ve duada kabul istegi sozu olmak uzere birbirine tarihsel olarak yakin ama islevce ayrilan uc ana alanda duzenlenir. Ortak bag kalbin yatismasi ve kabul duygusudur, fakat her dalin siniri guvenlik, tasdik ve dua formulu olarak ayri tutulmalidir.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
